ja.title: PRISMのEC50をそのまま次の実験濃度に使ってよいか
ja.summary: PRISMの公式実測データから3薬・6細胞株の濃度反応を再解析。点推定、profile、技術的redoを照合し、遷移付近への追測と独立再実験が必要な曲線を分ける。
ja.seo_title: PRISMのEC50をそのまま次の実験濃度に使ってよいか

en.title: Can a public PRISM EC50 choose the next experimental concentration?
en.summary: Hill fits, conditional profiles and technical redo comparisons distinguish usable transitions from unidentified EC50 values in a selected three-drug, six-cell-line dataset. Technical precision is not biological reproducibility.
en.seo_title: Can PRISM EC50 guide experimental concentrations?
en.seo_description: Selected PRISM curves are examined with Hill fits, conditional EC50 profiles and technical redo. Precision and biological reproducibility are distinguished.
